title: Switching from banjo to guitar; four months with Blue Parody
summary: He played guitar for the last year with Salvaggio and in Blue Parody, then left after four months for Streeman; guitar overtook banjo around 1932.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Did you ever play a job on guitar with Salvaggio?
I think the last year I switched over on guitar.
Yeah, I got that straight. I hope, anyway. Yeah. Then the Blue Parody you were playing? I was playing guitar. Guitar the whole time. Yeah.

I was only with Blue Parody four months now. Four months, yeah. When I had an opportunity to go with Streaming. So I grabbed that opportunity and I went with Streaming. Because they had a tremendous group. Not that the Blue Parody didn't, they had a good group too. But I knew a lot of the guys in the Streaming band and I really enjoyed working with that group besides the fact they got a tremendous amount of work. Why did you switch to guitar?
Well, because in 1932, guitarists sort of became real popular and banjos started dying down.
